title: ARWP Agent Skills

skills.name: arwp-growth-loop
skills.useWhen: Continuously improve Search, recommendation, generative Search, AI-citation or agent visibility using explicit hypotheses and measurement.

skills.name: arwp-adaptive-upgrade
skills.useWhen: A real target site has been audited and you need concrete, source-backed changes with exact surfaces, implementation recipes, verification contracts and measurement follow-up.

skills.name: arwp-target-transformation
skills.useWhen: Adaptive upgrades are selected and the agent has resolved exact target-repository files and grounded facts, so deterministic changes can be compiled, simulated, rolled back locally or delivered in a new production-path GitHub PR.

skills.name: arwp-prepare-site
skills.useWhen: Prepare or upgrade an existing website repository to ARWP and current Search/AI/agent technical guidance.

skills.name: arwp-ai-search-content
skills.useWhen: Improve articles, docs, comparison pages and answer pages for usefulness, retrieval and citation.

skills.name: arwp-dataset-publication
skills.useWhen: A target site has a genuine reusable corpus that should become a versioned, externally archived and DOI-citable dataset release.

skills.name: arwp-agent-discovery
skills.useWhen: Implement truthful llms.txt, Agent Skills, ARD, API/MCP/A2A/WebMCP discovery and optional ARWP profile surfaces.

skills.name: arwp-evidence-ci
skills.useWhen: Add assertion contracts, scheduled audits, evidence receipts and regression-safe CI.

guardrail: Skills implement and verify source-backed improvements. Target transformation is digest-gated, path-allowlisted and PR-first; policy/editorial/owner/runtime decisions remain gated. Dataset DOI publication applies only to genuine reusable corpora and is for citation/reproducibility, not a ranking promise.
